page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 40 virtual CPUs, corresponding to 20 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.8 GB of RAM per core. This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached volumes.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. In database and application tests, the instance processes 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a PassMark database operations score of 14249.04. For small-scale machine learning tasks, the system handles 7B model LLM inference at 12.71 tokens per second for text generation.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge delivers a balanced allocation of dedicated compute resources and memory without the added expense of bundled local NVMe storage or GPU hardware. The absence of local storage represents a clear tradeoff, requiring reliance on network storage which may impact I/O-heavy operations. This profile is highly suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, medium-sized database deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded CPU tasks such as software compilation and data decompression.
